facebook.caption:
POV: you take a random road in Phu Quoc and end up here.

Hộ Quốc Temple sits on the hillside like it belongs to a different century. Red gates, incense smoke, ocean somewhere behind you. 4.7 stars across 1,378 reviews and most tourists drive straight past.

Bring water. Wear covered shoulders. Go early before the heat wins.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Walking through the gates of Hộ Quốc Temple at golden hour. Incense smoke, red lanterns, and 1,378 people gave it 4.7 stars. Most visitors never stop here. Don't be one of them.
